an5.253:1.1: bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā nissayo dātabbo . . . pe . . . sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo. Katamehi pañcahi? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekhena samādhikkhandhena . . . asekhena paññākkhandhena . . . asekhena vimuttikkhandena . . . asekhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti. Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo ti.
